source_note: The 2026-10-05 exact UK manufacturer/retailer recheck retains differently based 8.0/8.2 kg claims, generic RCR 830 g and gross RCR-F Pro 1,010 g frame references, and differing Hadron 470/625 wheelsets. facts.drivetrain: UK reference: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 2×12; retailer detail lists R7100 components, 52/36 chainrings and 11–34 cassette. Mainland component package unverified.
facts.brakes: UK retailer reference: Shimano R7170 hydraulic discs, 160 mm front / 140 mm rear. Mainland component package unverified.
facts.frame: High-/super-high-modulus carbon in UK product references; exact RCR-F Pro frame-weight basis unresolved
facts.wheels: UK manufacturer overview: Swiss Side Hadron Classic 470. Exact UK retailer: HADRON² Classic 625, 62 mm rims. Wheelset specifications differ between pages; confirm the ordered build.
facts.tires: UK selected-model manufacturer card and retailer name Aero 111 front / GP5000 S TR rear. Retailer fitted widths are 26 mm front / 28 mm rear; the overview does not identify this front/rear mix. Confirm the ordered build.
facts.tire_clearance_basis: 32 mm maximum on the exact UK retailer record; fitted 26 mm front / 28 mm rear tyres are separate observations. Mainland-specific clearance remains unverified.
facts.complete_weight_basis: Van Rysel exact UK manufacturer page: 8.0 kg, size/protocol unstated; separate Decathlon regional catalog says 8.2 kg for size M with tubeless assembly. Same grey 105 Di2 product identity; unresolved conflict.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer reports the RCR-F head tube is 7% stiffer than RCR Pro to improve sprint performance; relative manufacturer claim without a public absolute protocol
facts.complete_weight_alternative_basis: Decathlon UK exact grey RCR-F Pro 105 Di2 listing: size M with tubeless assembly; conflicts with the Van Rysel manufacturer page’s unsized 8.0 kg claim.
facts.complete_weight_status: Conflicting exact UK product-page claims: 8.0 kg with no size/protocol vs 8.2 kg in size M with tubeless assembly; do not normalize.
facts.frame_weight_basis: The manufacturer page describes a generic RCR 830 g size-M frame reference. The exact UK retailer lists a 1,010 g gross RCR-F Pro frame in size M. Exact-frame association and measurement inclusions are unresolved; neither value is selected for comparison.
facts.regional_build_scope: UK product references only: whole-bike weight, exact frame attribution and wheelset specification remain unresolved. These observations do not establish the mainland China build, package weight, stock or checkout.
facts.fork: UK manufacturer selected-model card: HM carbon fork material. UK retailer: 420 g gross fork mass; inclusions and measurement protocol are unstated. The Hadron 470 number identifies the manufacturer wheel model. Mainland package weight remains unverified.
facts.powermeter: UK selected-model card: Inpeak Powercrank E single. UK retailer: INPEAK-E rechargeable sensor on the left R7100 crank. The stated descriptions align; the mainland component package is unverified.

comparison_eligibility.note: UK whole-bike claims use different bases at 8.0/8.2 kg, and the generic RCR 830 g frame reference is not established as the exact RCR-F Pro frame. Both complete and frame weights remain reference evidence rather than comparable or builder measurements.

audit_corrections.reason: Keep every prior literal and price date; qualify exact UK source fields and exclude both unresolved complete and frame weights from decisions. Current selected tyre/powermeter descriptions align; no mainland equivalence is inferred.
